description: PROP-011 (the regression test explicitly written to close iteration-11's FIND-029) asserts that $CAP's content and mtime are unchanged before/after a post attempt, but never asserts that the NEW TEMPORARY caption file itself is actually deleted after the attempt -- across ANY of the three outcome branches (published / unverified / failed) or the exception/timeout path. REQ-010 explicitly claims the temp file is 'cleaned up after the post attempt regardless of outcome,' but zero proof obligation in the entire PROP table (PROP-001..011) verifies this cleanup claim. This is a live-Instagram-posting feature that runs on an unattended repeating wake cycle (per HARD RULE 0.26, disk hygiene is a standing operational concern for exactly this kind of accumulating small artifact) -- an unverified cleanup claim on a script that fires repeatedly, unattended, indefinitely, is a real gap, not a cosmetic one.

evidence.snippet: "Also assert `$CAP`'s file content and mtime are IDENTICAL before and after a post attempt (FIND-029: `$CAP` is read-only ... only a separate temp file is written+read+cleaned-up)." -- no corresponding assertion that the temp file itself no longer exists post-attempt, in any outcome branch
